name: shape-slug-form-legacy-document-rejected
description: A stale slug-form document carrying the retired shape_id string member (and no shape member at all) is refused: shape_id is unknown and shape is missing, so a legacy document cannot mint beside the new ids.
notes: shape_id is not in the identity core's closed top-level member set, so this refuses unknown_member before the separately-missing shape member is ever checked.
